pr_title: fix(core): create component should always inside angular zone
pr_body:
Close #38260, #37223
related to #40860

When `bootstrap` or `dynamic` create component, it may happen outside of ngZone, such as
use a `route guard` outside of ngZone, or trigger `*ngIf` with a `eventListener` outside of ngZone,
so this PR ensure all component creation(view rendering) happen in the angular zone.
pr_comments: @atscott, this is related to #40860, this is a generic solution for the issue, since not only `router`, there also other cases may cause the similar issues. Please review this is a reasonable solution or not, thanks.
@JiaLiPassion does this replace #40860 or should this be merged in addition to that one?
@atscott , if this idea is ok, this will be a replace of #40860, since this will not only fix the issue of `router`, but also fix other similar issues.

issue_context.title: KeyEventPlugin forces event handler in `ngZone`, the behavior is different with non key event handler.
comments: @JiaLiPassion why keydown listener should run outside of zone in your example?
@artaommahe, since the `keydown` listener is added outside of `ngZone`, you can check this issue for more information https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/37062

@JiaLiPassion hm, but new behavior looks counter-intuitive. Developer needs to know some angular core stuff to understand why click/keydown is running outside angular zone despite they are just declared in template like any other event listeners.

@artaommahe , I totally understand your concerns and agree with your point, but this issue and related PR doesn't introduce a `new` behavior. The current behavior (except the events like `keydown.enter`) is `outside` ngZone. ```
``` In this case, the current behavior is 1. the `button click` is outside of ngZone. 2. the `keydown` is inside ngZone. Which is not consistent. And most cases are like `button` click, so this issue and PR just make `keydown.enter` behaves the same way as `button click`. Of course we can discuss this behavior is correct/confuse or not in another issue.

review_comments: Hey @JiaLiPassion . I've got a question regarding that. Since this is a public API this is likely introducing a relatively big breaking change from behavior standpoint where more views would be processed by change detection. We have components that are explicitly created outside of the zone manually via `factory.create()`. We could at least have some option to opt out from this behavior.

I also think that incorporating Zone logic in the primary rendering primitive itself is not really desirable; as @arturovt points out there are valid cases where one explicitly opts-out of zone tracking.

It currently works very consistently to me: every activity that originates from outside of the Zone will also run outside of the Zone. I would personally not even consider #37223 as a bug: I'd consider the code that leaves the Zone to also be responsible for re-entering the Zone when applicable. Without this symmetry the behavior becomes hard to reason about.
I agree, I don't believe we should be special casing this.
